explication: Intro Skipper is a Jellyfin plugin that analyzes local television media, detects intro and other skippable time ranges, stores them, and exposes them back to Jellyfin for playback skipping. Administrators can inspect, edit, suppress, restore, erase, and rescan segments through HTTP and the dashboard. The sampled code strongly supports database mutation, journaled Jellyfin projection, FFmpeg caching, visualization, and troubleshooting; analyzer-to-task wiring is represented only where the repository structure documents the responsibility.
